scientific_integrity: The Brownian two-Gumbel convolution is prior work; the claim is the critical finite-lattice correction 16c^3/3 and its sharp crossover. Finite exact tests check identities but do not prove asymptotics; an independent scientific audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only independent synchronous simple symmetric walks from one common start on C_n; the finite second-order limit covers log(k_n)/n^(2/3) -> c in [0,infinity); beyond it only loss of tightness, not a replacement centered law, is proved. No moment limit or extension to other walk rules is claimed.
title: The critical \(n^{2/3}\) walker-growth crossover for discrete-cycle cover times
